name: new-order-customer-ui-sync
title: Sync new order modal with customer manager UI
description: Align the manager new-order modal with the established Customer Management warm-neutral and sage visual system without changing the order workflow.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The modal now reuses the Customer Management warm-neutral, sage and charcoal system. Table and category controls are searchable Ant Design selects. Category labels are resolved from menus[].categoryMenu instead of the absent item.category object; orphaned category IDs are grouped into one Khác option. Menu text search also uses the resolved category name. CreateOrderForTable schema/resolver, useOrderManagement.saveOrder, restaurant scope, validation, draft restore and realtime side effects remain unchanged. Added focused helper tests. Tests, build and browser screenshots were not run in the connector environment; no GitHub workflow run or status was available for the latest commit.
